transcriber_notes: SnowPilot chart measured on the embedded 994x840 raster. Printed date 11/01/2022 agrees with the file name. Site printed 'Wawa Test Profile / Sunshine Village' with coordinates near Sunshine Village, while the file sits in the Simpson folder (task site_key simpson); transcribed as printed. Height axis 3.30 px/cm (0 cm y751, 180 cm y157); boundaries from bar outlines and dark-blue separator lines: 180/168/155/132/116/108/77/0 (+-0.4 cm), matching the Layer Notes ranges; 7 table rows match 7 bars. Only the 116-108 cm row has a grain form (□); all other grain, size and moisture cells are blank. Hardness bars grow leftward from x447, class lines F/4F/1F/P/K/I at x399/327/255/183/111/39 with 1/3-class ticks: 4F, P, 1F, P, 1F+, P, P (the SnowPilot logo overlaps the 168-155 cm bar edge). No temperatures drawn (no temperature axis).
